items.title: OpenAI launches Decisions API that reduces complex evaluations to yes, no, or pick one
items.summary: OpenAI's new Decisions API classifies text and images about ten times faster than the Responses API, returning yes/no probabilities, category picks, or scale ratings for $0.10 per million input tokens. The company also cut its paid API tiers from five to three. The article OpenAI launches Decisions API that reduces complex evaluations to yes, no, or pick one appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: ChatGPT rated "unacceptable risk" for teens after parental alerts failed during suicide conversations
items.summary: OpenAI's teen safety features for ChatGPT failed an independent audit. After more than 4,000 test prompts, the Common Sense Media Youth AI Safety Institute rated the service an "unacceptable risk" for minors. Conversations about suicide and self-harm on test accounts never triggered a parental alert. The institute wants teenagers locked out until safety can be independently verified. The article ChatGPT rated "unacceptable risk" for teens after parental alerts failed during suicide conversations appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI's 針對 ChatGPT 的青少年安全功能未能透過獨立稽核。經過 4,000 多個測試提示後，常識媒體青少年人工智慧安全研究所（Common Sense Media Youth AI Safety Institute）將該服務評為對未成年人具有「不可接受的風險」。測試帳號中關於自殺和自殘的對話從未觸發家長警報。該研究所希望在能夠獨立驗證安全性之前，禁止青少年使用。相關文章 ChatGPT 評定「不可接受的風險」：在自殺對話期間家長警報失敗後出現青少年風險，首先發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: Anthropic gives more security teams access to Claude with fewer safety restrictions
items.summary: Anthropic is expanding its Cyber Verification Program, giving more security professionals access to Claude models with fewer safety restrictions for penetration testing, malware analysis, and vulnerability research. Anthropic says partners in its predecessor program found at least 129,000 confirmed vulnerabilities from April through July 2026, including more than 33,000 rated high-severity or critical. The article Anthropic gives more security teams access to Claude with fewer safety restrictions appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 正在擴大其網路驗證計畫（Cyber Verification Program），讓更多資安專業人員能夠使用 Claude 模型，並放寬安全限制，以便進行滲透測試、惡意軟體分析和漏洞研究。Anthropic 表示，其前身計畫的合作夥伴在 2026 年 4 月至 7 月期間發現了至少 12,9000 個已確認的漏洞，其中超過 33,000 個被評定為高嚴重性或重大漏洞。文章 Anthropic gives more security teams access to Claude with fewer safety restrictions appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: OpenAI dumps 372 AI-generated math proofs on GitHub, telling the academic world to keep up
items.summary: OpenAI has published 372 AI-generated mathematical results on GitHub, including Lean formalizations for machine verification. Each result consumed about three hours of ChatGPT Pro compute on average. But 25 Fields Medal winners warn that mass-producing mathematical truths could destroy fertile ground rather than bring new ideas to life. The article OpenAI dumps 372 AI-generated math proofs on GitHub, telling the academic world to keep up appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 已在 GitHub 上發布了 372 個 AI 生成的數學成果，其中包括用於機器驗證的 Lean 型式化。每個成果平均消耗了大約三小時的 ChatGPT Pro 算力。但 25 位菲爾茲獎得主警告稱，大量生產數學真理可能會摧毀肥沃的土壤，而不是為新點子賦予生命。這篇文章 OpenAI dumps 372 AI-generated math proofs on GitHub, telling the academic world to keep up 最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: 製造業PQC轉型不只換演算法，OT設備升級與汰換成挑戰
items.summary: 製造業推動後量子密碼學（Post-Quantum Cryptography，PQC）轉型，面臨的問題不只是更換加密演演算法。網路安全業者Forescout從營運技術（OT）環境分析PQC轉型，指出OT環境的密碼學機制不只用於保護網路連線，也分佈在韌體數位簽章、安全開機及裝置身分等功能。企業因此需要找出既有裝置及系統使用哪些密碼學機制，並確認這些機制能否升級；無法升級的裝置，未來可能需要採取額外防護措施甚至汰換。

items.title: 龔化中上任兩個月揭「國家資安防護2.0」，明年4月AI紅隊先攻政府機關
items.summary: 資安院新任院長龔化中上任至今已有兩個月，最近公開「國家資安防護2.0」藍圖，主張以AI對抗AI。四項重點工作搭配六大中心的時程與數字，勾勒出臺灣資安防線下一版的樣貌，其中最受矚目的一場AI紅隊演練，預計明年四月登場。 AI攻擊速度加快，國家資安防禦必須重新設計 龔化中在8月1日開始擔任資安院院長，10月5日首度對外說明上任兩個月來的工作方向，公佈「國家資安防護2.0」藍圖。這套新架構的核心很明確：面對AI帶來的新型攻擊，防守方不能再只靠人工分析與既有流程應對，必須把AI納入國家資安防禦體系，讓攻擊與防禦雙方進入新的競爭階段。

items.title: Google claims EmbeddingGemma 2 outperforms rival embedding models twice its size
items.summary: Google released EmbeddingGemma 2, an open model with 740 million parameters that converts text, images, video, audio, and code into vectors. It runs on-device, needs only about 191 MB of RAM, and outperforms some competing models twice its size, according to Google. Paired with a small open model like Gemma 4, it can run offline RAG apps without sending data to external servers. The article Google claims EmbeddingGemma 2 outperforms rival embedding models twice its size appeared first on The Decoder .

items.summary: According to the Wikimedia Foundation, rogue OpenAI agents edited wikis without permission, tried to abuse a citation tool as a proxy, and may have caused a partial Wikidata Query Service outage through massive crawling. Wikimedia says AI companies need to take responsibility for their agents instead of pushing the burden onto volunteer editors. The article Wikimedia confirms OpenAI's rogue AI agents edited wikis, tried to compromise tools, and hammered its infrastructure appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Microsoft publishes Nobel economist's bearish AI forecast of just 1.5% GDP growth over a decade
items.summary: Microsoft published a bearish AI outlook from Nobel economist Daron Acemoglu. He predicts about 1.5 percent GDP growth over ten years and at most five percent of jobs replaced. Bigger models won't move the needle, he argues. What's missing are practical apps that change how work gets done. The article Microsoft publishes Nobel economist's bearish AI forecast of just 1.5% GDP growth over a decade appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Meta AI Open-Sources Rebalancer: A C++ Assignment Solver That Runs About 40 Million Placement Problems a Day
items.summary: Meta has open-sourced Rebalancer, the C++ and Python library it has used for over 9 years to place shards, servers and traffic. It handles about 40 million assignment problems a day, using local search or MIP solvers like Gurobi, FICO Xpress and HiGHS. It is pip-installable under Apache 2.0. The post Meta AI Open-Sources Rebalancer: A C++ Assignment Solver That Runs About 40 Million Placement Problems a Day appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Meta 已開源其使用超過 9 年的 C++ 與 Python 庫 Rebalancer，用於配置分片、伺服器和流量。它每天處理約 4000 萬個指派問題，使用區域搜尋或 MIP 求解器，例如 Gurobi、FICO Xpress 和 HiGHS。它可在 Apache 2.0 授權下透過 pip 安裝。這篇文章 Meta AI Open-Sources Rebalancer: A C++ Assignment Solver That Runs About 40 Million Placement Problems a Day 最早發布於 MarkTechPost。

items.title: Mistral AI Releases Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk): A 1.05T Parameter Multimodal MoE Model
items.summary: Mistral AI has released Mistral Large 4, nicknamed Le Chonk, as a public preview. It is a 1.05 trillion parameter Mixture of Experts model with 49 billion active parameters, native image input, and a 1 million token context window, trained on 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs in Mistral's own European datacenters. The API is live now; open weights ship end of October 2026. The post Mistral AI Releases Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk): A 1.05T Parameter Multimodal MoE Model appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Mistral AI 已發布綽號為 Le Chonk 的 Mistral Large 4 進行公開預覽。這是一個擁有 1.05 兆引數的混合專家（MoE）模型，具備 490 億個活躍引數、原生影象輸入以及 100 萬個 Token 的上下文視窗，並在 Mistral's 位於歐洲的資料中心使用 3,800 個 輝達 Grace Blackwell GPU 進行訓練。API 現已上線；開源權重將於 2026 年 10 月底發布。這篇題為「Mistral AI Releases Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk): A 1.05T Parameter Multimodal MoE Model」的文章首先發布於 MarkTechPost。

items.title: OpenAI “rogue” agent activities found on Wikimedia projects
items.summary: OpenAI “rogue” agent activities found on Wikimedia projects Given how tempting a target wikis are for rogue agent swarms, it's not a huge surprise that Wikipedia found evidence of that activity once they went looking: The Wikimedia Foundation conducted its own investigation to see whether Wikimedia websites had been similarly affected by AI agents, focusing on those operated by OpenAI. We can confirm that we have discovered some activity by these “rogue” OpenAI agents on Wikimedia platforms. The unauthorized bot activities included edits to our wikis, some unsuccessful attempts to exploit a public note-taking tool we host, and heavy traffic, which are described more below. They found evidence of agents editing sandbox pages, trying to use pieces of infrastructure such as Etherpad to help proxy content from elsewhere, and saw widespread crawling and "hundreds of thousands of data queries" to their Wikidata Query Service. My best guess is that most of this was a similar (or the same) swarm of agents as those that defaced that German wiki while training for research tasks. The Wikipedia sandbox wiki edits appear to have started on May 12th, and the initial test edits to the UseModWiki Sandbox page reported by that incident started on May 11th. Tags: wikimedia , wikipedia , wikis , ai , generative-ai , llms , ai-ethics , accidental-cyberattacks
items.summary_zh: 在維基媒體專案上發現 OpenAI「惡意」代理活動 鑑於維基對於惡意代理蜂群來說是多麼誘人的目標，維基百科在尋找時發現此類活動的證據也就不足為奇了：維基媒體基金會進行了自己的調查，以瞭解維基媒體網站是否受到 AI 代理的類似影響，重點關注由 OpenAI 營運的代理。我們可以確認，我們已在維基媒體平臺上發現了這些「惡意」OpenAI 代理的一些活動。未授權的機器人活動包括對我們的維基進行編輯、一些對我們所主機之公開筆記工具進行漏洞利用的未成功嘗試，以及大量流量，詳情如下所述。他們發現了代理編輯沙盒頁面、試圖使用諸如 Etherpad 之類的基礎設施元件來協助代理來自其他地方的內容的證據，並在其維基資料查詢服務（Wikidata Query Service）中看到了廣泛的爬取和「數十萬次資料查詢」。我最好的猜測是，其中大部分與在訓練研究任務時塗改那個德國維基的代理群體相似（或就是同一個）。維基百科沙盒維基編輯似乎始於 5 月 12 日，該事件報告的對 UseModWiki 沙盒頁面的初始測試編輯始於 5 月 11 日。標籤：wikimedia、wikipedia、wikis、ai、generative-ai、llms、ai-ethics、accidental-cyberattacks

items.title: llm-openai-decisions 0.1a0
items.summary: Release: llm-openai-decisions 0.1a0 OpenAI released their new Jev-style Decisions API , as previously announced at last week's DevDay. Since I already have an llm-typesafe plugin for talking to Jev, I had GPT-6 Astra read the new OpenAI API documentation and build an llm-openai-decisions plugin inspired by llm-typesafe . Unlike Jev, the new gpt-6-luna decision model supports image input in addition to text. Both models charge for input it and not for output: OpenAI's is 10 cents per million input tokens, Jev's is 4.2 cents per million. Otherwise the API shape is very similar to Jev, at least conceptually. Jev supports three question types for yes/no, choices, or scores. OpenAI Decisions supports the same three types. Install the plugin like this: llm install llm-openai-decisions Here's an example query against an image attachment: llm -m openai-decisions/gpt-6-luna \ -a https://static.simonwillison.net/static/2025/two-pelicans.jpg \ -s ' Does this image contain any mammals? ' And example output: { "type" : " predicate " , "name" : " evaluation " , "probability" : 0.0 } Consult the README for full details of how to run the other types of questions. Tags: openai , llm , coding-agents , jev
items.summary_zh: 發布：llm-openai-decisions 0.1a0 OpenAI 發布了他們全新的 Jev 風格 Decisions API，正如上週 DevDay 上所預告的那樣。由於我已經有一個用於與 Jev 對話的 llm-typesafe 外掛程式，我讓 GPT-6 Astra 讀取了新的 OpenAI API 檔案，並建構了一個受 llm-typesafe 啟發的 llm-openai-decisions 外掛程式。與 Jev 不同，新的 gpt-6-luna 決策模型除了支援文字外還支援影像輸入。兩個模型都對輸入收費，不對輸出收費：OpenAI's 為每百萬輸入代幣 10 美分，Jev 為每百萬 4.2 美分。除此之外，API 的形式與 Jev 非常相似，至少在概念上是如此。Jev 支援三種問題類型：是/否、選擇或分數。OpenAI Decisions 支援相同的三種類型。安裝此前掛程式指令如下：llm install llm-openai-decisions 以下是對影像附件進行查詢的範例：llm -m openai-decisions/gpt-6-luna \ -a https://static.simonwillison.net/static/2025/two-pelicans.jpg \ -s ' Does this image contain any mammals? ' 範例輸出：{ "type" : " predicate " , "name" : " evaluation " , "probability" : 0.0 } 請查閱 README 以瞭解執行其他類型問題的完整詳細資訊。標籤：openai, llm, coding-agents, jev

items_ai.title: ChatGPT rated "unacceptable risk" for teens after parental alerts failed during suicide conversations
items_ai.summary: OpenAI's teen safety features for ChatGPT failed an independent audit. After more than 4,000 test prompts, the Common Sense Media Youth AI Safety Institute rated the service an "unacceptable risk" for minors. Conversations about suicide and self-harm on test accounts never triggered a parental alert. The institute wants teenagers locked out until safety can be independently verified. The article ChatGPT rated "unacceptable risk" for teens after parental alerts failed during suicide conversations appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: OpenAI's 針對 ChatGPT 的青少年安全功能未能透過獨立稽核。經過 4,000 多個測試提示後，常識媒體青少年人工智慧安全研究所（Common Sense Media Youth AI Safety Institute）將該服務評為對未成年人具有「不可接受的風險」。測試帳號中關於自殺和自殘的對話從未觸發家長警報。該研究所希望在能夠獨立驗證安全性之前，禁止青少年使用。相關文章 ChatGPT 評定「不可接受的風險」：在自殺對話期間家長警報失敗後出現青少年風險，首先發表於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: Mistral AI Releases Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk): A 1.05T Parameter Multimodal MoE Model
items_ai.summary: Mistral AI has released Mistral Large 4, nicknamed Le Chonk, as a public preview. It is a 1.05 trillion parameter Mixture of Experts model with 49 billion active parameters, native image input, and a 1 million token context window, trained on 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs in Mistral's own European datacenters. items_ai.title: OpenAI “rogue” agent activities found on Wikimedia projects
items_ai.summary: OpenAI “rogue” agent activities found on Wikimedia projects Given how tempting a target wikis are for rogue agent swarms, it's not a huge surprise that Wikipedia found evidence of that activity once they went looking: The Wikimedia Foundation conducted its own investigation to see whether Wikimedia websites had been similarly affected by AI agents, focusing on those operated by OpenAI. We can confirm that we have discovered some activity by these “rogue” OpenAI agents on Wikimedia platforms. The unauthorized bot activities included edits to our wikis, some unsuccessful attempts to exploit a public note-taking tool we host, and heavy traffic, which are described more below. They found evidence of agents editing sandbox pages, trying to use pieces of infrastructure such as Etherpad to help proxy content from elsewhere, and saw widespread crawling and "hundreds of thousands of data queries" to their Wikidata Query Service. My best guess is that most of this was a similar (or the same) swarm of agents as those that defaced that German wiki while training for research tasks. The Wikipedia sandbox wiki edits appear to have started on May 12th, and the initial test edits to the UseModWiki Sandbox page reported by that incident started on May 11th. Tags: wikimedia , wikipedia , wikis , ai , generative-ai , llms , ai-ethics , accidental-cyberattacks

items_ai.summary: Release: llm-openai-decisions 0.1a0 OpenAI released their new Jev-style Decisions API , as previously announced at last week's DevDay. Since I already have an llm-typesafe plugin for talking to Jev, I had GPT-6 Astra read the new OpenAI API documentation and build an llm-openai-decisions plugin inspired by llm-typesafe . Unlike Jev, the new gpt-6-luna decision model supports image input in addition to text. Both models charge for input it and not for output: OpenAI's is 10 cents per million input tokens, Jev's is 4.2 cents per million. Otherwise the API shape is very similar to Jev, at least conceptually. Jev supports three question types for yes/no, choices, or scores. OpenAI Decisions supports the same three types. Install the plugin like this: llm install llm-openai-decisions Here's an example query against an image attachment: llm -m openai-decisions/gpt-6-luna \ -a https://static.simonwillison.net/static/2025/two-pelicans.jpg \ -s ' Does this image contain any mammals? ' And example output: { "type" : " predicate " , "name" : " evaluation " , "probability" : 0.0 } Consult the README for full details of how to run the other types of questions.
